name: Ramapo CIT Camp
description_short: Counselor in training program for Ramapo residents entering grades 9 and 10, held at the town's mini camp sites. Teens train for a week, observe for a week, then help counselors with camp groups, with trips in weeks 4 to 6 such as Dorney Park and a Spirit Cruise.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests go in writing to the Parks & Recreation Department; medical refunds need a doctor's note. No refunds once a program has begun, and a $50 per camper surcharge applies to cancellations.
notes: Ramapo residents only; one rate, $500. 8:30 am to 1:30 pm. Registration was closed (full) for summer 2026 when checked.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. CIT 1 & CIT 2 page: full for 2026, Ramapo residents only, July 6 to August 14, 8:30 to 1:30, entering grades 9 and 10, mini camp sites at Suffern Middle School and Connor Elementary School, fee $500. Ages derived from grades.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Registration page: residents register from March 2, non-residents from April 13 if space allows; optional payment plan fee $25 per family; refund surcharge $50 per camper; fee increases after June 12, 2026.
Researched by Claude from this page. Ramapo Parks Contact Us page: the department's offices are in Pomona, Hillburn and Suffern, NY. State only; no camp site address.
